## [[{{< iconify fluent:live-24-filled >}}]{.bigger}[Live]{.polling .Bigger} [{{< iconify fluent:live-24-filled >}}]{.bigger} [Polling]{.polling .Bigger}](https://github.com/seandavi/quarto-revealjs-live-questions)

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Setup

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%" .smaller}

...if you have a GitHub account:

1. sign--up at [{{< iconify logos:cloudflare >}}](https://www.cloudflare.com/)
2. "Deploy" [via extension hyperlink](https://github.com/seandavi/quarto-revealjs-live-questions#cloudflare-worker--durable-object)  
3. insert server address into YAML

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "8-10"
---
title: "Week 3"
format: revealjs
filters:
  - live-questions
revealjs-plugins:
  - live-questions
live-questions:                         #<1>
  server: https://live-questions.xxx
  session: descriptivename              #<1>           
---

```
1. `server` value provided by CloudFlare, `session` value is user--provided (something meaningful for your intended application)

:::

:::

### Execution

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

+ (at least) 4 different .qmd question ***types*** (poll, quiz, word cloud, rating scale)  
+ QR code takes respondent to polling location (on phone)

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

+ slides with QR code also [reflect polling results](https://jtkulas.github.io/LiveStreams/slides/2026/11_3_26/#/which-language-do-you-use-most)  
+ presenter controls active poll (phones synched to presenter action -- [multiplex](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/presenting.html#multiplex)--ish)

:::

:::
